post.title: The average AI creature walked 1.0. 40 generations later, 1756
post.caption: In gen 1 the average AI creature moved 1.0 and the best managed 273. Gen 6: best 904. Gen 15: 1838. By gen 40 the average creature walks 1756 and the best 2652. Each creature is a small neural network driving its legs; the ones that get farthest are copied with mutations.
post.pinned: Each creature is a small neural network that drives its legs. No one tells it how to walk. The ones that travel farthest get copied with random mutations into the next generation. Numbers are distance in sim units.
post.notes: Extra reel (Ansh asked for more, Nov 25). Seed 4662. best: g1 273.4, g2 428.8, g6 904.1, g9 1169.4, g15 1838.4, g24 2119.2, g40 2652.5; mean g1 1.0, g40 1756.7. Decimals dropped (rounded down). Idea test: relatable/question/reaction = 3 of 4.
